name: onLiveStrokeChanged
desc: Called when the live stroke preview changes, for relay forwarding.

name: onPortalTap
desc:
Called when a portal is tapped (toggled), so the relay can forward
the portal index to the peer.

name: onStrokeAdded
desc: Called when a completed stroke is added, for relay forwarding.

name: onTokenAdded
desc: Called when a new token is added locally, for relay forwarding.

name: onTokenMoved
desc: Called when a token is moved locally, for relay forwarding.

name: onTokenRemoved
desc: Called when a token is removed locally, for relay forwarding.

name: openPortals
desc: Set of portal indices that are currently open.

name: rawMapBytes
desc: Raw bytes of the loaded .dd2vtt file.

name: removeToken
desc: Removes a token by id.

name: resetCalibration
desc: Clears calibration data, returning to default zoom behavior.

name: revealAll
desc: Reveals all fog cells on the map.

name: revealMode
desc: Whether the brush reveals or hides fog.

name: revealedCells
desc: Set of revealed fog cell indices.

name: setBrushRadius
desc: Sets the fog brush radius.

name: setDrawColor
desc: Sets the drawing color for new strokes.

name: setDrawWidth
desc: Sets the drawing line width for new strokes.

name: setInteractionMode
desc: Sets the active interaction mode (fog, draw, or token).

name: setLiveStroke
desc: Updates the live stroke preview, or clears it if stroke is null.

name: showGrid
desc: Whether the grid overlay is visible on the map.

name: showWalls
desc: Whether wall debug outlines are displayed.

name: strokes
desc: Completed freehand strokes drawn on the map.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the full state to a JSON-compatible map for relay broadcast.

name: toggleFog
desc: Toggles fog of war on/off.

name: toggleGrid
desc: Toggles grid overlay visibility on/off.

name: togglePortal
desc: Toggles a portal (door/gate) between open and closed.

name: toggleReveal
desc: Toggles a single fog cell between revealed and hidden.

name: toggleRevealMode
desc: Toggles revealMode between reveal (true) and hide (false).

name: toggleWalls
desc: Toggles wall debug outline visibility on/off.

name: tokens
desc: All tokens currently placed on the map.

name: tvWidthInches
desc: Physical width of the TV screen in inches.

name: undoStroke
desc: Removes the most recently added stroke (undo).

name: WallComponent
desc: Renders wall outlines from line_of_sight data. DM debug view only.
